title: My Courses navigation loses student shell
original_expected: Student opens My Courses, course detail, and lesson while retaining the student shell and returning to the appropriate list.
root_cause: My Courses opened the public /courses/:id route outside StudentLayout and its return link used the public catalog.
frontend_files: frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx; frontend/src/pages/MyCoursesPage.jsx; frontend/src/pages/CourseListPage.jsx; frontend/src/pages/CourseDetailPage.jsx; frontend/src/pages/LessonPage.jsx; frontend/src/components/layouts/StudentLayout.jsx; frontend/src/pages/CourseLearning.css; frontend/src/pages/MyCoursesPage.css
api_impact: Adds nested student catalog/detail routes; preserves public routes and lesson URL family.
evidence: Nested routes/source links and production build; `01-course-navigation-and-responsive.md`.
remaining_risks: Direct refresh/back/role redirects and visual shell require browser QA; two-column breakpoint awaits image confirmation.

title: Lesson PDF does not render inline
original_expected: Authorized learner can preview supported PDFs in lesson context; restricted materials return no bytes; downloads preserve name and bytes.
root_cause: Lesson UI only exposed attachment download and there was no protected inline-preview endpoint.
api_impact: Adds protected GET /api/v1/materials/:id/preview; keeps download endpoint/attachment response; shares Phase 1 policy.
evidence: Phase4 integration validates auth/enrollment/allowDownload/status, inline headers, signature, size, external no-proxy, attachment bytes/name.
remaining_risks: Native PDF viewer/mobile, browser memory, network loss, and restricted-preview product policy remain unverified.

title: Vocabulary lacks discovery/navigation tools
original_expected: Search English/Vietnamese meaning; filter topic; sort; navigate long lists; display responsive vocabulary cards and back-to-top.
root_cause: Student page had only topic selection and an unbounded list; endpoint lacked search/sort/pagination.
api_impact: Adds optional search/topic/sort/page/limit/ids behavior and pagination metadata; old no-parameter full-list behavior retained.
evidence: Phase4 integration covers accent search/topic/sort/page/literal regex/legacy behavior.
remaining_risks: Rendered search debounce, keyboard behavior, long-list scrolling, and actual responsive grid need browser QA.

title: Flashcard Previous/Next labels are English
original_expected: Learner can move between flashcards using Vietnamese Previous/Next controls.
root_cause: Visible navigation labels were in English.
evidence: Source now labels controls “Trước” and “Tiếp theo”; bounded page loading retained.
remaining_risks: Keyboard focus/disabled appearance and next-page interaction need browser QA.

title: Download failure uses success-green notice
original_expected: Error, success, warning, and informational outcomes use distinct semantic states and accessible announcements.
root_cause: Shared learning notice used a green success style irrespective of result.
evidence: Typed status classes, alert/status roles, polite/assertive live regions in source; build passes.
remaining_risks: Browser notice colors, stale state, and assistive-technology announcement unverified.

title: Enrollment confirmation is a full page
original_expected: Open a course-specific confirmation dialog; cancel sends no API call; confirm sends one request and preserves error context.
root_cause: Enrollment used a separate confirmation page rather than a popup.
api_impact: No enrollment handler change; legacy route redirects into the single existing enrollment API flow.
evidence: Native dialog source has confirm-only request path, synchronous duplicate guard, loading/error state, scroll lock; build passes.
remaining_risks: Cancel/no-request, focus/Escape, duplicate request, auth redirect, and mobile interaction need browser/API interaction QA.

title: Lesson has no difficulty attribute
original_expected: Admin/teacher may set a lesson level; student sees it; legacy unset lessons remain unclassified and publication policy is unchanged.
root_cause: Lesson model and create/edit forms omitted the field.
api_impact: Create/update accept optional normalized enum; invalid values fail with INVALID_LESSON_DIFFICULTY.
evidence: Phase4 integration checks enum create/update/clear/reject and legacy unset; build passes.
remaining_risks: Difficulty taxonomy is proposed; form save/reload and student badge visual need product/browser verification.
